consumers.mountApi: window.TimmyRive.mountConsole(host, { size, words, label, heading, name, place, identity: { project, session }, caption }) · mountProviderCard(host, providerId, { size, words, label, name, place, providerName, detail }) · mountActionButton(host, { label, action, disabled, name, place, theme }); `words`: 'beside' (the default: the HTML status word beside the face) | 'spoken' (the status in the accessibility tree and off the screen while the face is drawn — a screen whose own words sit beside the face); a console's or card's `label`, `caption`, `identity` and `detail` are accepted and kept on the handle (the Inspect view reads them) — a production face draws none of them (consumers.production)
consumers.handle: root, unmount(), setLabel(words) (an ActionButton's Caption; a console's or card's state word and headline), setDisabled(bool), setProvider({ name, detail }) on a card (the name goes to the face's aria-label), place, mounted
consumers.feeds: fromSse(event, data, source) · fromProviderState(id, word, source) · stopping(source) · reconcile(word, { turn, source })
consumers.identity: a 'turn' event names the feed's current turn (data.id); 'needs-you' / 'done' of another turn are ignored as stale (recorded, never applied); 'done'.receipt is attached to the handle; stopping = STOP REQUESTED until 'done' cancelled
consumers.shape: timmy-rive props { w, h, component, state, label, provider } unchanged; AS SAVED / NOT A LIVE JOB until a feed event reaches it on its page
consumers.versions: the bindings tell v1 from v2 by the runs present (v2: Caption on every production artboard); v1's runtime workarounds (the caption overwrite, the scaled pill) apply to a v1 file only
consumers.label: the face's HTML label (span.tr-status, aria-live=polite: the live region) shows the OBSERVED word the feed gave (fromProviderState's stateWord: H170's "checked" / "pending" / …; the derivation's data-state), never the vocabulary's word beside it (R86: one word per card); the vocabulary word stays the State mapping (data-state, the shape's saved prop, inspect().word); inspect().shown and the label's data-observed say the observed word when it differs

production.rule: the operator's item 4 (2026-10-24 19:18; the lead's ruling of 19:24): a PRODUCTION face — one a screen mounts through mountConsole / mountProviderCard (handle.mounted; inspect().mounted) — carries ONE thing, the state: the HTML state word as its headline in EVERY pose and the mark the state animates. Runtime-only (runs and labels): no rebuild; the artboards are unchanged
production.headline: Headline{Idle|Working|Approval|Stopped|Failed} all read labelWord(handle) — the IDENTICAL string the HTML status reads ("checked", "pending", "not set up", "idle", "working", "awaiting approval", "stopping", "stopped", "failed"): no capitalised twin, no second vocabulary; a pose change keeps the word and moves the mark (f165d8c7's "Checked" on HeadlineIdle only is superseded)
production.hidden: Title, Tag, Caption read "" at EVERY size (f165d8c7's 320-px threshold is superseded); on a ProviderCard ProviderName, ProviderState, ProviderDetail read "" too (the state is the headline; the provider's name is the card's HTML title and the face's aria-label); on the AgentConsole Line{pose} reads ""; the ActionButton is untouched (its Caption is its own label)
production.accessibleName: a mounted role=img face's aria-label is the state word (the console: "working"), with the provider's name after it on a card ("checked · OpenRouter" — mountProviderCard's providerName / setProvider({ name }), else the id's own words); it follows every state change; a mounted ActionButton keeps its own label as its name (a button's name is its action; its HTML twin is unchanged)
production.liveRegion: the status span beside the face stays the live region (aria-live=polite, the same word as the headline); with `words: 'spoken'` it is off the screen while the face is drawn and beside the fallback glyph while it is not (rive-components.css: .tr-mount[data-words=spoken][data-rive=drawn] .tr-status) — a screen must never display:none it (that silences the announcement)
production.sameString: the face's headline run and the HTML status word are compared equal by the suite (tests/companion-rive-browser.test.ts): one word, drawn once legibly — on the face where it is large enough, in the HTML where the screen keeps it
production.notProduction: the Inspect view's faces (the preview artboards) and the Studio's timmy-rive shape are not mounts: they draw the artboard as authored — Title / Tag / Caption (PREVIEW · AS SAVED / NOT A LIVE JOB · LIVE), ProviderName / ProviderState / ProviderDetail, the baked headlines and lines; the Inspect view is the place to read a face
production.inspect: inspect().runs.production = { headline, hidden: [the run names set to ""], faceWidth, note }; inspect().runs.headline.poses and .line.poses read every pose's run back; inspect().faceName is the face's aria-label; inspect().mounted / .words
